αἰέν: αἰέν — always, ever; adv., epic by-form of αἰεί (= Attic ἀεί)
δεδιδάχθαι: διδάσκω — teach; perf. pass. inf., after φασιν: ’(they say) you have been taught’, the teacher given by προτί + gen.
δειλοὶ: δειλός — wretched, pitiable; masc. voc. pl., in address
διατρίψας: διατρίβω — rub through, crush by rubbing; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having rubbed (it) fine’
δικαιότατος: δίκαιος — just, righteous; superl. masc. nom. sg., with partitive gen.: ’most just (of the Centaurs)’
εὐρύπυλ: Εὐρύπυλος — Eurypylus; masc. voc. sg., elided Εὐρύπυλ’ (= Εὐρύπυλε), in address
κελάρυζε: κελαρύζω — gurgle, plash; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκελάρυζε): ’gurgled, welled’
κενταύρων: Κένταυροι — the Centaurs; masc. gen. pl.
λιαρῷ: λιαρός — warm, tepid; neut. dat. sg., agreeing with ὕδατι
μαχαίρῃ: μάχαιρα — knife; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic μαχαίρᾳ), instrumental: ’with a knife’
μεθήσω: μεθίημι — let go, give up (+ gen.); fut. 1 sg.: ’I will let go of, abandon’
νίζ: νίζω — wash; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided νίζ’ (= νίζε): ’wash’ · also impf. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (= ἔνιζε): ’was washing’
νότιος: νότιος — moist, dripping (from νοτίς ’moisture’; not νότιος ’southern’); masc. nom. sg., of sweat
περιπευκές: περιπευκής — very sharp, keen (περι- intensive; root of ἐχεπευκής); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with βέλος
πεσέονται: πίπτω — fall; fut. 3 pl. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic πεσοῦνται): ’will fall’
πικρὴν: πικρός — bitter, sharp-tasting; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ῥίζαν
προτί: πρός (epic προτί) — toward, at, from; prep. + gen. of the source after a verb of learning: ’from (Achilles)’
σάωσον: σαόω (= σῴζω) — save, keep safe; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’save’
σκάζων: σκάζω — limp; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’limping’
σχήσουσι: ἔχω — have, hold, hold back; fut. 3 pl. (stem σχ-, fut. σχήσω): ’will hold back, check’
ταχέας: ταχύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic -έας (= Attic ταχεῖς), agreeing with κύνας: ’swift’
τειρομένοιο: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. mid./pass. masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), agreeing with σεῖο: ’distressed’
φασιν: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl., enclitic: ’they say’ (+ acc. and inf.)
φθίσονται: φθίνω — perish, waste away; fut. 3 pl. mid. (φθίσομαι): ’will perish’
χρηΐζοντα: χρηΐζω — need, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. part. act. masc. acc. sg., epic -ΐζω (= Attic χρῄζω): ’needing’
ἀντεβόλησε: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’met’
ἀργέτι: ἀργής — bright, white, gleaming; masc. dat. sg., epic ἀργέτι (= ἀργῆτι), agreeing with δημῷ: ’white (fat)’
ἄσειν: ἄω — sate, glut (+ dat. of what with); fut. inf. (the aor. inf. is ἆσαι), after ἐμέλλετε: ’to glut’; Attic uses κορέννυμι
ἐδίδαξε: διδάσκω — teach; aor. 3 sg., augmented, + acc. of the pupil: ’taught (him)’
ἐκτανύσας: ἐκτανύω — stretch out; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stretched (him) out’
ἐμέλλετε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined; impf. 2 pl., augmented, + fut. inf.: ’you were destined to’
ἐνίσπω: ἐνέπω — tell, relate; aor. subj. 1 sg. (ἐνίσπον), in a purpose clause after ὄφρ’: ’that I may tell’
ἐτετεύχατο: τεύχω — make, build; plpf. pass. 3 pl., epic -ατο (= Attic ἐτετεύχηντο): ’had been built’
ἔκταμ: ἐκτάμνω (= ἐκτέμνω) — cut out; aor. imper. 2 sg., elided ἔκταμ’ (= ἔκταμε; Attic ἔκτεμε): ’cut out’
ἔρχομαι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. 1 sg.: ’I am going’
ἕλκεος: ἕλκος — wound, sore; neut. gen. sg., epic ἕλκεος (= Attic ἕλκους)
ἤην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἰητροὶ: ἰητρός — healer, physician; masc. nom. pl., Ionic (= Attic ἰατροί)
ὀδυνήφατον: ὀδυνήφατος — pain-killing (lit. ’pain-slaying’); fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ῥίζαν
ὀδύνας: ὀδύνη — pain, grief, anguish; fem. acc. pl.
ὑπέχευε: ὑποχέω — pour or spread beneath; epic aor. 3 sg., augmented (= Attic ὑπέχεε): ’spread under’
ᾤκτειρε: οἰκτείρω — pity; aor. 3 sg., augmented (οι- → ῳ-): ’pitied’

__broaden__.ἕκτορ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. voc. sg., in address · also masc. acc. sg., epic elided Ἕκτορ’ (= Ἕκτορα), object of σχήσουσι: ’Hector’ (πελώριον Ἕκτορ’ ’huge Hector’)
__broaden__.ἤ: ἤ — truly, indeed; asseverative particle (= ἦ), as printed in ἤ τοι, with τοι ’to you’ · also ἤ = εἰ, ’whether’, in an indirect question (ἴδηται ἤ ῥά τί οἱ … ἦε καὶ οὐκί) · also ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (ἠὲ … ἤ ’either … or’) · also ἤ = ἦ, interrogative particle opening a direct question: ’can it be that …?’ (ἤ ῥ’ ἔτι που σχήσουσι … ’can they still, I wonder, hold back …?’)
__broaden__.ἵνά: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj. + subj. (accent from the following enclitic) · also relative adv., ’where’ + indic. (ἵνά σφ’ ἀγορή τε θέμις τε ἤην ’where their assembly and court of right were’)
__broaden__.ῥέξομεν: ῥέζω — do, perform; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic short vowel (or fut.), after ἵνα μή: ’(that) we do (not)’ · also deliberative, in a direct question: ’what are we to do?’ (τί ῥέξομεν ’what shall we do?’)
__broaden__.μένει: μένος — force, might, fury; neut. dat. sg., with ἀντιόωσιν: ’my might’ · also μένω — stay, remain; pres. 3 sg.: ’stays’ · also μένω with acc.: ’awaits, waits for’ (μένει ὀξὺν Ἄρηα ’awaits keen war’)
__broaden__.πάσσε: πάσσω — sprinkle; impf./aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπασσε): ’sprinkled’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’sprinkle’ (ἐπὶ … πάσσε ’sprinkle on’)
__broaden__.σεῖο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic σεῖο (= Attic σοῦ), after περί: ’about you’ · also gen. of comparison after a comparative: ’than you’ (σεῖο … ὀλοώτερος ’deadlier than you’) · also gen. governed by εἵνεκα: ’on your account’ (εἵνεκα σεῖο) · also gen. sg. after ἀπό: ’away from you’ · also gen. object of μεθήσω: ’let go of you’ (σεῖο μεθήσω ’I will not give you up’)
__broaden__.τὰρ: ἄρα — then, so; τὰρ is taken as τε + ἄρα run together (compare τίς τ’ ἄρ), after interrogative τίς: ’who then?’ · also after interrogative πῶς: ’how then?’ (πῶς τὰρ ἔοι τάδε ἔργα ’how then could this be?’)
__broaden__.φίλων: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. gen. pl. · also attributive with ἑτάρων: ’dear (companions)’ · also substantive, ’loved ones’, in a phrase with πατρίδος αἴης (τῆλε φίλων ’far from loved ones’)
__broaden__.ἐσθλά: ἐσθλός — good, noble, excellent; neut. acc. pl., as a noun: ’good things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adjective, agreeing with φάρμακα: ’good (drugs)’
__broaden__.ἀργαλέοιο: ἀργαλέος — grievous, painful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου) · also neut. gen. sg., agreeing with ἕλκεος: ’grievous (wound)’
